license_required.quote: Every person who desires to practice dentistry or dental hygiene in this state must obtain a license to do so as hereinafter provided

issuing_authority.quote: the State Board of Dental Examiners may deny the issuance or renewal of a license or may revoke or suspend the license of any licensed dentist

name.value: Mississippi State Board of Dental Examiners
name.quote: the Mississippi State Board of Dental Examiners may, in its discretion, issue to the applicant a license to practice dentistry

type.quote: The State Board of Dental Examiners shall each year elect from their number a president, vice president and secretary-treasurer

age_minimum.quote: Be of good moral character, be possessed of a high school education, and have attained the age of twenty-one (21) years

moral_character_required.quote: Be of good moral character, be possessed of a high school education, and have attained the age of twenty-one (21) years

degree_required.value: Graduation from an ADA-accredited dental school
degree_required.quote: Exhibit with the application a diploma or certificate of graduation from the ADA accredited dental school

accrediting_body.value: Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association (ADA)
accrediting_body.quote: a graduate of a dental school accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association (ADA), or its successor commission

exams.name: National Board Examinations Parts I and II (Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations)
exams.notes: Required unless applicant graduated from an accredited dental school before 1960
exams.quote: Have successfully completed Parts I and II of the National Board Examinations of the Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations, or its successor commission, unless the applicant graduated from an accredited dental school before 1960

exams.name: Clinical licensure examination (state or regional)
exams.notes: Required for licensure by credentials; applicant must not have failed a clinical exam in the past five years
exams.quote: Has passed a state or regional clinical licensure examination and, within the past five (5) years, has not failed a clinical licensure examination administered by another state, jurisdiction, or regional licensing board

exams.name: Written jurisprudence examination
exams.quote: Successfully passes a written jurisprudence examination

available.quote: the board, in its sole discretion, may grant a license to a candidate who meets the following criteria

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid, unrestricted, unexpired license in a state with equivalent standards that grants reciprocity to Mississippi licensees; must have been in active practice or full-time dental education for the past five years; must have passed a state or regional clinical licensure examination; must not have failed a clinical exam in the past five years; must pass a written jurisprudence examination; and must meet other criteria in § 73-9-24.
requirements.quote: Currently hold a valid, unrestricted and unexpired license in a state whose standards for licensure are determined by the board as equivalent to Mississippi's standards, and which state grants reciprocity or licensure by credentials to licensees of the State of Mississippi

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall practice, attempt to practice or offer to practice dentistry or dental hygiene within the state without first having been authorized and issued a license by the board

credential_type.quote: Every person who desires to practice dentistry or dental hygiene in this state must obtain a license to do so as hereinafter provided

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall practice, attempt to practice or offer to practice dentistry or dental hygiene within the state without first having been authorized and issued a license by the board

title_protection.quote: No licensed dentist shall hold himself or herself out to the public as a specialist, or publicly announce as being specially qualified in any particular branch of dentistry, or publicly announce as giving special attention to any branch of dentistry, until he or she has been issued a certificate by the board authorizing him or her to do so

scope_protection.quote: No person shall practice, attempt to practice or offer to practice dentistry or dental hygiene within the state without first having been authorized and issued a license by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation or material misrepresentation in obtaining, renewing, or attempting to obtain or renew a license or professional credential.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation in obtaining a license, or attempting to obtain, obtaining, attempting to renew or renewing a license or professional credential by making any material misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful violation of any rules or regulations duly promulgated by the board or by another state's dental licensure agency.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful violation of any of the rules or regulations duly promulgated by the board, or of any of the rules or regulations duly promulgated by the appropriate dental licensure agency of another state or jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being impaired in the ability to practice with reasonable skill and safety by reason of illness, alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or mental or physical condition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being impaired in the ability to practice dentistry or dental hygiene with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness or use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material or as a result of any mental or physical condition

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing, or prescribing any prescriptive medication or drug outside the course of legitimate professional dental practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering, dispensing or prescribing any prescriptive medication or drug outside the course of legitimate professional dental practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of or pleading nolo contendere to a violation of any federal or state law regulating possession, distribution, or use of narcotic or controlled substances.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a violation of any federal or state law regulating the possession, distribution or use of any narcotic drug or any drug considered a controlled substance under state or federal law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing incompetently or negligently, regardless of whether there is actual harm to the patient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing incompetently or negligently, regardless of whether there is actual harm to the patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of or pleading nolo contendere to a crime in any jurisdiction that relates to the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a crime in any jurisdiction that relates to the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of or pleading nolo contendere to a felony in any jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a felony in any jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating professional responsibilities to a person not qualified by training, experience, or licensure to perform them.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Delegating professional responsibilities to a person who is not qualified by training, experience or licensure to perform them

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusal, revocation, suspension, or other restriction of a license by another state's licensing authority.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The refusal of a licensing authority of another state or jurisdiction to issue or renew a license, permit or certificate to practice dentistry or dental hygiene in that jurisdiction or the revocation, suspension or other restriction imposed on a license, permit or certificate issued by the licensing authority

disciplinary_grounds.description: Surrendering a license in another state when the board has reasonable cause to believe the surrender was made to avoid or in anticipation of disciplinary action.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Surrender of a license or authorization to practice dentistry or dental hygiene in another state or jurisdiction when the board has reasonable cause to believe that the surrender is made to avoid or in anticipation of a disciplinary action

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any unprofessional conduct as determined by the board on a case-by-case basis, including moral turpitude, fraud, false name, false advertising, inadequate sanitation, sexual misconduct, and other specified acts.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any unprofessional conduct to be determined by the board on a case-by-case basis, which shall include, but not be restricted to, the following: Committing any crime involving moral turpitude. Practicing deceit or other fraud upon the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a lawful board order, failure to cooperate with a board investigation, or failure to comply with a lawfully issued subpoena.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of a lawful order of the board previously entered in a disciplinary or licensure hearing; failure to cooperate with any lawful request or investigation by the board; or failure to comply with a lawfully issued subpoena of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful, obstinate, and continuing refusal to cooperate with the board in observing its rules and regulations in promptly paying all legal license or other fees required by law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful, obstinate and continuing refusal to cooperate with the board in observing its rules and regulations in promptly paying all legal license or other fees required by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing dentistry or dental hygiene while the person's license is suspended.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing dentistry or dental hygiene while the person's license is suspended

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of provisions relating to deceptive advertisement by health care practitioners.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation(s) of the provisions of Sections 41-121-1 through 41-121-9 relating to deceptive advertisement by health care practitioners

definition_quote.value: "Dentistry" is defined as the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention and/or treatment (nonsurgical, surgical or related procedures) of diseases, disorders and/or conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area and/or the adjacent and associated structures and their impact on the human body; provided by a dentist, within the scope of his or her education, training and experience, in accordance with the ethics of the profession and applicable law
definition_quote.quote: "Dentistry" is defined as the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention and/or treatment (nonsurgical, surgical or related procedures) of diseases, disorders and/or conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area and/or the adjacent and associated structures and their impact on the human body; provided by a dentist, within the scope of his or her education, training and experience, in accordance with the ethics of the profession and applicable law

methods_authorized.quote: the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention and/or treatment (nonsurgical, surgical or related procedures) of diseases, disorders and/or conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area and/or the adjacent and associated structures

drug_authority.value: Licensed pharmacists are authorized to fill prescriptions of legally licensed and registered dentists for any drugs to be used in the practice of dentistry.
drug_authority.quote: Legally licensed pharmacists of this state are hereby authorized to fill prescriptions of legally licensed and registered dentists of this state for any drugs to be used in the practice of dentistry

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: To employ, in its discretion, technical and professional personnel to conduct dental office sedation site visits

specialist_license_available.quote: Any dentist of this state licensed by the Mississippi State Board of Dental Examiners, who has complied with the requirements specified by the Council on Dental Education of the American Dental Association, or its successor council or commission, in a specialty branch of dentistry or who has otherwise met the requirements of the rules and regulations promulgated by the board may apply for a certificate as a specialist

specialty_practice_scope_restriction.quote: Any applicant applying for a specialty license by credentials must stay within his or her board recognized specialty and must practice only that specialty within the State of Mississippi

specialty_advertising_disclaimer_require.quote: Announcing a specialized practice shall be considered advertising that tends to deceive or mislead the public unless the dentist announcing as a specialist conforms to other statutory provisions and the duly promulgated rules or regulations of the board pertaining to practice of dentistry in the State of Mississippi

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: The work of dental hygienists and dental assistants while working in the office of a regularly licensed and registered dentist shall at all times be under the direct supervision of the dentist. Dental hygienists in the employ of the State Board of Health or public school boards shall be limited to only performing oral hygiene instruction and screening when under the general supervision and direction of regularly licensed and registered dentists.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person or persons to practice or offer to practice dentistry under, or use the name of any company, association or corporation or business name or any name except his or their own in a manner which is in violation of Section 73-9-61, or to operate, manage or be employed in any room, rooms or office where dental work is done or contracted for, and that is operated under the name of any company, association, trade name or corporation

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: A written work authorization shall accompany all dental laboratory work sent by a licensed dentist to a commercial dental laboratory or private dental laboratory technician

patient_record_retention_years.quote: The original of said written authorization shall be kept on file by a commercial dental laboratory or a private dental laboratory technician for a period of time required by the State Board of Dental Examiners, not to exceed two (2) years from the date it was received

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: A current certificate in cardiopulmonary resuscitation
